title: Chart-to-Experience: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Predicting Experiential Impact of Charts

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the mean and standard deviation of MLLM-generated 7-point Likert scale ratings against human crowdsourced baseline data to identify systematic over-scoring (positivity bias), under-scoring, and reduced variance in model judgments.

Qualitatively analyzing MLLM-generated explanations in pairwise chart comparisons to identify systematic deviations from human judgment, such as an algorithmic preference for visually complex or vividly colored charts that human evaluators find unreadable or chaotic.
